reviewMethod: All 18 selected current-generation stored files were independently rehashed and matched to the frozen 17:15 evidence snapshot; task/page/article/source DOI, figure identity, original labels/captions and content-addressed object metadata were checked. SVG/PNG files were rendered/decoded and individually viewed on five contact sheets against the current paper titles and captions. No publisher recrawl, new literature/scope decision, TOC reassignment, old sealed-media release or automatic marker-only approval was used.
quality: 15 SVG and 3 PNG files are preserved as captured. PNG files are 520 px wide captures and are not represented as publisher-maximum resolution. Existing correct TOCs and body images must not be replaced by different files without a separate replacement review.
